preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 2 and 10^5, inclusive.
The parent of each vertex (i + 1) is a vertex p_i, where p_i is between 0 and i, inclusive.
Each vertex is either white (0) or black (1).

postconditions.description: The output is the number of ways to split the tree such that each resulting part has exactly one black vertex, modulo 1000000007.
